subject: Request: CSA/CAIQ digital walkthrough + specific evidence samples
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@greenbank.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CSA/CAIQ digital walkthrough + specific evidence samples

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. As discussed, GreenBank's security team requested a focused walkthrough of our CSA/CAIQ crosswalk that maps controls to artifacts. To make the session productive we wanted to surface a few concrete items up front so we can target evidence that matters for your reviewers: 

- Short demo of token/key lifecycle: where keys are generated, rotation cadence, and HSM/KMS usage.
- Example runtime telemetry (sample trace showing request routing, tenant id scrubbed) for API interaction windows.
- Control mapping excerpt for IAC/infra provisioning (who approves, pipeline audit logs).

I've attached a preliminary crosswalk (redwood_csa_crosswalk_v1.xlsx) and a short runtime log export we can scrub ahead of the session. Can you confirm the preferred format for evidence ingestion (SFTP, secure Drive link, or a FedRAMP-compatible portal)? Also propose 45 minutes next week for the walkthrough — we can make that longer if your team needs to step through artifact collection end-to-end.

Proposed times (PST):
- Wed 28 Apr 11:00–11:45
- Thu 29 Apr 09:30–10:15

Thanks — we'll tailor the session to your checklist so your auditors don't spend time on low-value artifacts.

Best,

Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_csa_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (xlsx), runtime-telemetry-sample.log (text)
From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@greenbank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: security-team@greenbank.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: CSA/CAIQ digital walkthrough + specific evidence samples

Grace — thanks for the notes and the crosswalk.

We can take the artifacts over SFTP. Our intake team prefers: a vendor folder with a manifest.csv that lists artifacts, timestamp, and the control ID (e.g., CCM-L2-10). For the walkthrough we'll have 2 folks: me and Ravi (security engineer). We want to focus on: key management (KMS/HSM attestations), runtime isolation (tenant IDs, KV cache behavior), and logging/retention proofs.

Wed 28 Apr 11:00–11:45 ET works for us (that would be 08:00 PT). If you need PST slots please confirm.

Also, can you confirm whether the runtime logs will contain any customer-identifiable information? We need sanitized samples for the review.

Thanks,
Emily Ross
Sr. InfoSec Manager — Vendor Risk
GreenBank
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@greenbank.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 06:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CSA/CAIQ digital walkthrough + specific evidence samples

Emily — great, thanks for confirming the intake method and the reviewers. A couple of clarifications so the manifest lines up with your intake schema: 

1) For key management we'll include:
   - KMS key policy excerpt (kms-key-policy-20270401.pdf)
   - HSM attestation snapshot (hsm-attest-20270315.pdf)
   - Rotation schedule and automation playbook (rotation-playbook.md)

2) For runtime isolation and telemetry:
   - Scrubbed runtime sample (runtime-telemetry-sample.log) — all tenant IDs replaced with hashed values; no PII.
   - Explanation doc mapping CAIQ control CCM-2.x -> runtime artifact (runtime-control-mapping.md)

3) For logs/retention we'll provide retention-policy.pdf and a 30-day rolling log sample slice.

We're preparing an SFTP account now. Expected inbound: SFTP host sftp.greenbank-secure.com, credentials to be shared by you/the intake team. Once you confirm the access route we'll upload a manifest.csv and the encrypted artifact bundle.

Grace and I will run the demo; David Kim will join the upload/ops portion to show the automation for artifact generation and retention hooks.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
